debug.description: Which debug files the agent writes (see docs/DEBUG-EXCHANGE.md). Each flag: off | errors | full (true = full, false = skip). all_off = true silences all.

routing.description: Model routing, pushed to the router (POST /router/settings). mode = auto | plan | free | safe | paid. safety_check = off | short | mixed-safe (RISKY: changing it needs confirm). free_accept_edits = true lets free models apply edits. spread = true spreads load over the free models. chain = ordered list of provider names ([] = router default). Invalid values fall back to the default with a note.

budget.description: Token budget. weekly_used_pct is OWNER-ONLY data (null = unknown): the kit never writes it. The three *_pct thresholds say at which weekly_used_pct the governor warns, throttles (free tiers only) and blocks paid work. release_token_budget = tokens one release may spend (0 = no limit).

agents.description: Agent limits. max_parallel = agents the relay planner runs at once (1-6, default 3). tier_by_task_kind = model tier per kind of task (T0 free local, T1 free cloud, T2 cheap paid, T3 strong paid). lab_permission_block = true keeps the Lab permission block (T-085) on.

console.description: Agent Console look. language = it | en. palette = dark | light | contrast. page_size = rows per page in console lists (5-200). Invalid values fall back to the default with a note.

skills.description: Skill loading. enabled = list of skill names that are on ([] = none switched on). learn_mode = every-change (learn from each change) | gated (learn only when a gate passes). second_brain = true keeps the second brain on.
